fieldDescription: Tiles (default): icon tiles; Tile unfold sets how they show names. Stretched: keeps the vanilla button count per row. Five per row: fits five named buttons per row. All layouts fill the panel width with Storage at the bottom right. Reopen the screen to apply.

Tiles only. On hover (default): the tile under the cursor expands to show its name; the last hovered tile stays open. On click: only the selected market's tile expands when clicked. Never: icons only; names show in the tooltip. Reopen the screen to apply.
Seconds to expand a tile with On hover or On click. Default: 0.1. Set to 0 for instant expansion. Reopen the screen to apply.
Animated (default): lights move around the selected button in its faction's color. Bright band: a fixed outline. Off: vanilla appearance. Reopen the screen to apply.
Trims square background corners that stick out past the button frame. On by default. Reopen the screen to apply.
